question: Close the 2.1.1.0 loose ends: (c) the three Stage 8 items skipped on 13 October (optic render FOV, reload timing, selector graph still built from the 1.4.3.0 export); (d) whether reference-data/frosty/roster-values.json equals the 19 October roster refresh and which name joins broke; (f) the 2.1.1.0 patch-notes inventory entry.

serialized: Optic render FOV: 157 raw files under Common/Hardware/Weapons hold a render FOV (Field_7768ebf2) or Class_86ce0d70 zoom definition in both 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0; 0 values changed. 8 files are new in 2.1.1.0 (Mk 24, ELR-40, DEVGRU, MRGGS, Z84M, RSPR and Machete WBs, and WPM_SCP_FML19 at 55). WPM_SCP_ElcanDR Class_bfd4f199 Field_149939ab and Field_e9129d03 went 1.0005 to 0.55 with its FOV unchanged at 38. OptionFieldOfViewScaleADS is byte-identical.

Reload: for all 67 site weapons with a ReloadInfoArray[0], site tacRld equals (ReloadDelay + PostReloadDelay + ReloadTimeBulletsLeft) / ReloadSpeed of that entry in 2.1.1.0 raw; 62 emptyRld equal ReloadTimeBulletsLeft / ReloadSpeed of entry [1]. M4A1: (0 + 0 + 2.15) / 0.977272 = 2.2000017 in float32, equal to the site value. Mk 24 2.534 / 2.95, ELR-40 2.4 / 4.083, Z84M 7.6 / 9.334 and RSPR 2.334 / 3.1 equal the stored values, ReloadSpeed 1.0.

Selector graph: builds/2.1.1.0/xml is an empty directory. scripts/frosty-configuration.py runs in raw mode on 2.1.1.0 (69 weapons, 3,656 attachment records, 18 issues). For the 63 launch weapons 2.1.1.0 raw gives 3,399 records against 3,308 on 1.4.3.5 raw: 9 changed (branches), 91 added, 0 removed; against the 1.4.3.0 XML build 11 changed, 91 added, 1 removed. 1.4.3.5 raw equals the 1.4.3.0 XML graph on 3,306 of 3,308 common records.

Roster: reference-data/frosty/roster-values.json (sha256 e5912a62...3030) is the 1.4.3.5 pass; roster-compact.json of the 19 Oct run (sha256 16255bd1...bf19) is the 2.1.1.0 pass. Both hold 167 items with the same ids. The run's raw-checks.json has 11,902 checks, 11,902 matched, 0 mismatches; 300 re-read here, 0 mismatches. Registry owners 722 to 745; two name joins (veheq_upg_fieldmain to Passives_Vehicles_IFV_Regeneration and _MBT_Regeneration) point at owners that no longer exist; 25 new owners are unjoined.

Patch-notes inventory: updates[] entries carry version, articleDate, url, season, localBuild, two change groups, releaseDate and mechanicsRead; no per-line status exists. add-frosty-pending.mjs is not in the research repo (an unrelated file of that name is in the Analyzer repo).

inference: The stored ReloadSpeed behaves as a divisor of the stored reload times: it turns the 16 'capture-based' frames-over values of L4007 into exact matches. This is a numeric match, not an observation of play.
Render FOV and zoom definition values are unchanged, so entry 11's source basis is unchanged; whether the Elcan DR multiplier pair 1.0005 to 0.55 has any visual effect is not inferred.

The graph differences are additive attachments (Actuated Module, DD Vertical, polymer links, one HTI bolt) and a few changed modifier lists; raw mode reproduces the XML graph where nothing changed, so the 2.1.1.0 raw graph can replace the 1.4.3.0 XML graph for non-optic attachments.
The patch-notes line status in the draft entry is derived from the checklist Result column; it is an inference from the checklist, not a field of the inventory.
unresolved: needs capture: Common/Hardware/Weapons/_WeaponModifiers/_Ergo/MatchTrigger/WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15 and its selector U_WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15 (HK433 Match Trigger graph incomplete)
The 11 graph records changed against the 1.4.3.0 XML build were classified by field only (branches); their meaning was not read.
Roster name joins for the Field Maintenance upgrade (and Base_ and ResetHealthRegenOnFire owners) need a hand decision.
articleDate of the EA 2.1.1.0 article is not known from the checklist.
That the stored ReloadSpeed is the factor the game applies to the tactical reload is inferred from the numeric match, not observed in play.
siteImpact: No site change. Conditional: none of the optic render FOV values, reload sums or selector graph changes moves a site number; site tacRld and emptyRld equal the stored values (with ReloadSpeed) on all 67 weapons that have an entry, so a future reload rule can use (delay + post delay + ReloadTimeBulletsLeft) / ReloadSpeed instead of capture offsets. WPM_SCP_FML19 (thermal, render FOV 55) and the HK433 Match Trigger W15 package are not fully in the raw tree.

leads.title: 2.1.1.0 loose ends: Stage 8 optic FOV, reload timing and selector graph; roster refresh; patch-notes entry
leads.summary: Optic render FOV and zoom values are unchanged on 157 shared files (8 new files); site reload times equal the stored phase sum divided by ReloadSpeed on all 67 weapons including the four Season 5 weapons; the selector graph builds from 2.1.1.0 raw and differs from the 1.4.3.0 XML graph by 91 added and 11 changed records; the repo roster-values.json is still the 1.4.3.5 pass and two name joins are dead.
leads.reopenWhen: A new build changes an optic file, a reload entry or a weapon attachment record, FML19 or HK433 Match Trigger W15 is captured, or the operator accepts the roster join edits.
